prompt.en: Why did the first European explorers call the peoples they met in Canada "Indians"?
prompt.fr: Pourquoi les premiers explorateurs européens ont-ils appelé « Indiens » les peuples qu'ils ont rencontrés au Canada?

options.en: Because they thought they had reached the East Indies.
options.fr: Parce qu'ils croyaient être arrivés aux Indes orientales.

options.en: Because it was the name those peoples used for themselves.
options.fr: Parce que c'était le nom que ces peuples se donnaient.

options.en: Because a French king chose the name.
options.fr: Parce qu'un roi de France a choisi ce nom.

options.en: Because it was the name used on the earliest maps of Europe.
options.fr: Parce que c'était le nom utilisé sur les plus anciennes cartes d'Europe.

explanation.en: The name came from a mistake in navigation, not from the peoples themselves. The first explorers believed they had reached the East Indies.
explanation.fr: Ce nom vient d'une erreur de navigation, et non des peuples eux-mêmes. Les premiers explorateurs croyaient être arrivés aux Indes orientales.

source.quote: because the first explorers thought they had reached the East Indies.

verification.evidence: When Europeans explored Canada they found all regions occupied by native peoples they called Indians, because the first explorers thought they had reached the East Indies.
